title: The Lion and the Little Mouse

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Roooar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who's that? It's Leon the lion!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Lions roar! Can you roar like Leon? Roar!

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Ha ha! What a big roar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Here are four amazing lion facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number one. A lion's roar is so loud, you can hear it far, far away.

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Roar! Can you hear me, friends?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number two. Lions love to sleep. They nap for most of the day!

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Yawn... nap time.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you yawn like Leon? Yaaawn!
vo.tts: Can you yawn like Leon? Yawn!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number three. A baby lion is called a cub.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: A cub! Like me! I'm a bear cub!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And number four. Lions live together in a big family, called a pride.

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: This is my pride! My family!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Squeak, squeak!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And this is Pip, a tiny little mouse.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Hello! I'm small, but I'm quick!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Mice have long whiskers. They use them to feel their way, even in the dark!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Twitch, twitch!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you squeak like Pip? Squeak, squeak!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One sunny day, Pip was rocking her three baby mice to sleep, in a cosy nest.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Shh... sleep, little ones. Sleep...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then along came Leon, feeling very, very happy.

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: What a beautiful day! Roooar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh no! The baby mice woke up, and began to cry.

vo.speaker: babies
vo.text: Waah! Waah!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Leon! Your big roar woke up my babies!

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Oh! I'm so sorry, Pip. I didn't see your nest.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Shh, shh... it's okay, little ones.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Leon wants to say hello to the babies. How can he do it, without waking them up?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Roar even louder!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: No, Leo! He can use a quiet voice!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Leon took a big breath, and tried a little roar.

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Rrroar...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The babies wiggled. Still too loud!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Try a whisper, Leon. Like this. Psst, psst.

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Hello... little ones...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The babies smiled, and fell fast asleep.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's count the sleeping babies, very quietly.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: One...

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: two...

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: three.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you whisper like Leon? Hello... little ones...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When the babies woke up, Leon gave them a gentle ride!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Wheee! Thank you, Leon! You're a gentle giant!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Hold on tight! Bumpity, bumpity, bump!

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: I'm big, but I can be gentle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And from that day on, Leon roared far away in the hills, and whispered near the nest.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Being gentle is a super power. Use a soft voice when someone is sleeping!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Wow! I was wrong! The quiet voice worked!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Shh... I can be gentle, too!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When do you use a quiet voice?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What sound does a lion make?

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: Roar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is a baby lion called?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: A cub!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How many baby mice did Pip have?

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Three little babies!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why did the baby mice cry?

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Leon's big roar woke them up!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How does a mouse feel its way in the dark?

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: With my long whiskers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Leon say hello to the babies?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: With a whisper!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what is the lesson?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Be gentle, and use a soft voice!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Gentle hands,

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: gentle voice!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now you! Gentle hands, gentle voice!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Bye bye, friends! Squeak!

vo.speaker: leon
vo.text: See you next time... shh!
